lines: +# Simulate verifier/solve apt resolution in isolated apt roots (no docker available).

+    printf 'deb [trusted=yes] http://%s/debian %s main
deb [trusted=yes] http://%s/debian-security %s main
deb [trusted=yes] http://%s/debian %s main
' "$host" "$rel" "$host" "$sec" "$host" "bullseye-updates" > "$R/etc/sources.list"

+    printf 'deb [trusted=yes] http://%s/debian %s main
deb [trusted=yes] http://%s/debian-security %s main
deb [trusted=yes] http://%s/debian %s main
' "$host" "$rel" "$host" "$sec" "$host" "bookworm-updates" > "$R/etc/sources.list"
+  APT="apt-get -o Dir::Etc=$R/etc -o Dir::State=$R/state -o Dir::State::status=$R/state/status -o Dir::Cache=$R/cache -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false -o APT::Architecture=amd64"
+APT="apt-get -o Dir::Etc=$R/etc -o Dir::State=$R/state -o Dir::State::status=$R/state/status -o Dir::Cache=$R/cache -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false -o APT::Architecture=amd64"
+echo "===== bullseye policy ====="; $AC policy curl sshpass expect libnghttp2-14 2>&1 | grep -A2 -E "^(curl|sshpass|expect|libnghttp2-14):"
+( cd /tmp && rm -f curl_*.deb sshpass_*.deb libcurl4_*.deb; $APT download curl sshpass 2>&1; ls -la curl_*.deb sshpass_*.deb 2>&1 )
+APT="apt-get -o Dir::Etc=$R/etc -o Dir::State=$R/state -o Dir::State::status=$R/state/status -o Dir::Cache=$R/cache -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false -o APT::Architecture=amd64"
+echo "===== bookworm policy ====="; $AC policy clang llvm gcc-mips-linux-gnu libc6 2>&1 | grep -A2 -E "^(clang|llvm|gcc-mips-linux-gnu|libc6):"
+( cd /tmp && rm -f clang_*.deb; $APT download clang 2>&1; ls -la clang_*.deb 2>&1 )
